_note: Reasons by hand, and only ONE argument has ever been valid: the markup is a THIRD PARTY's, it is captured into a specimen so we can see it, and the defect is real on the live site and tracked. 'It is only a specimen' is not a reason - a specimen with a real a11y bug in it is a real a11y bug on a real page. Every entry must say what is broken, whose it is and what the plan is. An entry that matches NOTHING is a failure, not a pass: a stale allowlist that silently covers nothing is how srgate passed on nothing for three commits.

allow.aria-input-field-name::select2-selection: SELECT2, AND IT IS REAL. Two controls on /my-account/edit-address/billing/ and on checkout: select2 draws a span with role="textbox" aria-readonly="true" inside its role="combobox", and gives the INNER one no accessible name. The outer combobox is named correctly (aria-label="Страна / Област"), so a screen reader announces the field and then meets an unnamed textbox inside it. This is select2's own markup, unmodified - CSS cannot fix it. PLAN: stop shipping select2 on these fields. It is also the one WooCommerce stylesheet the dequeue misses (handle 'select2' matches no prefix in the sweep), and we already have a select component, so turning it off removes the sheet, the two violations and a dependency in one move. Owner decision pending because it costs type-ahead search on the country list. See claude/PROFILE_AND_SELECT2_20260811.md.
